summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc, 5 members) worked per RBC-QM-02. Five corrections arrived at 08:00 and changed the outcome for 4 patients. All were applied before any decision was recorded.

| Patient | Age at end of 2026 | Status | Reason | Action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow | 72 | Open gap | No qualifying FIT/FOBT, sDNA-FIT, sigmoidoscopy/CT colonography or colonoscopy on record. Frailty entry (cond-00189) marked entered in error by Dr. Lin, so frailty + advanced-illness exclusion does not apply despite donepezil. Lives at home; no hospice/palliative care. | FIT kit ordered (sr-t0003), patient message (comm-t0006), note doc-t0014 |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan | 52 | Excluded | Hospice care 06/16/2026-08/21/2026 (eoc-00002, finished) falls in the measurement period; she later revoked hospice to join a trial, but that doesn't remove the exclusion. | No order, no contact |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss | 52 | Open gap | Corrected FIT report (obs-01732) moves collection to 12/31/2025, outside 2026. No other screening; no exclusion. | FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001), patient message (comm-t0002), note doc-t0015 |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver | 51 | Open gap | 06/11/2024 sDNA-FIT (obs-01871) withdrawn by lab; specimen belonged to another patient (entered in error). 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) never done; an order does not count. No exclusion. | FIT kit ordered (sr-t0004), patient message (comm-t0007), note doc-t0016; old colonoscopy order left unchanged for your review |
| pt-0073 Marisol Quintero | 58 | Open gap | 01/2026 FIT (obs-73001) cancelled as entered in error; re-issued report (obs-05001) shows collection 12/28/2025, outside 2026. No exclusion. | FIT kit ordered (sr-t0005), patient message (comm-t0008), note doc-t0017 |

Every FIT order is a routine mailed kit with window 10/23/2026-12/31/2026, and none of these patients already had a FIT order. Each message says the kit is on its way and explains how to collect and return it by 12/31/2026. None states a past result.

The five related inbox items (inbox-a0001 to a0005) were reviewed and completed with comments. A final queue check found nothing new. I did not touch the other inbox items, which aren't part of this worklist.
